findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: semanto_review_get · Public sink: semanto_whoami, semanto_status, semanto_setup_read_again, semanto_setup_choose, semanto_review_get, semanto_setup_confirm, semanto_sign, semanto_pages_changed, semanto_install_guide, semanto_install_check, semanto_receipts_list.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: semanto_review_get · Public sink: semanto_whoami, semanto_status, semanto_setup_read_again, semanto_setup_choose, semanto_review_get, semanto_setup_confirm, semanto_sign, semanto_pages_changed, semanto_install_guide, semanto_install_check, semanto_receipts_list

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
